questions.question: Describe your experience reviewing vendor invoices, verifying receiving information, resolving billing inaccuracies, and entering invoice data. What controls did you use to ensure accuracy?

In your HR Director role, you administered medical insurance and supported employees with applications and approvals. How did you document those processes and communicate status to employees and management?

This role requires clear written requirements and process documentation. Tell us about a process, policy, form, report, or procedure you documented or improved. What was your approach and who used it?
Give an example of a time you had to explain a detailed payroll, billing, insurance, or administrative issue to someone with a different level of knowledge. How did you make sure they understood?
What experience do you have using Microsoft Office to create reports, track operational information, prepare documentation, or communicate findings? Which tools did you use and for what purpose?
Describe a situation where you identified an error or discrepancy in financial, payroll, invoice, or other operational data. How did you investigate it and what was the outcome?
How would you facilitate a session with billing operations staff, technical teams, and business leaders to understand a problem and document the requirements for a system change?
What is your understanding of the SDLC, and how would requirements, process flows, approvals, and traceability support a project using Waterfall versus Agile Scrum methods?

This position involves presenting to executive-level audiences. Describe a time you presented information, recommendations, or status updates to supervisors or stakeholders. How did you prepare and handle questions?

Suppose a health insurance billing team reports that member invoices are being generated with incorrect amounts. What questions would you ask, what process flow would you create, and what documentation would you produce before proposing a solution?
